game_concept: A arcade set in Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair, a basalt column stairway: the forge smith must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split obsidian shards evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Basalt Stair: a basalt column stairway
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read n. Display Above when n > 4; otherwise display At or below. Test dataset 9: {'n': 2}; {'n': 7}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Basalt Stair'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

source_player_objective: Collect 220 points of obsidian shards by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 220, or lives reach 0.
